name: Chestnut lacquer (广漆, 栗壳色)
process: True lacquer for the garden's timber in the Jiangnan manner: raw lacquer (the sap of the lacquer tree, Toxicodendron vernicifluum) mixed with boiled tung oil, laid in thin coats that cure, not dry, in warm humid air as the enzyme laccase polymerises the urushiol. The film is a translucent brown, deep and glossy, the grain faintly visible under it: Suzhou's chestnut-shell colour, unpainted.

guangqi.text: 广漆 is a mixture of natural raw lacquer and boiled tung oil; its colour runs from purple-brown to purple-red with its lacquer content, semi-transparent.
guangqi.source: 雅昌艺术市场监测中心 (2018) 明清家具透明涂料的成分与鉴别 [The composition and identification of the clear finishes of Ming and Qing furniture], 2018-10-10, https://amma.artron.net/observation_shownews.php?newid=1030835

photograph: A deep, warm, dark brown gloss like a chestnut's shell; the grain faintly visible; hand-worn edges lighter and polished.
Outdoors, a fine craze and loss of gloss on sunlit faces.
